coordinate_frame: Original STEP global CAD coordinates, metres; +Y is upright in the supplied reference

support_plane.interpretation: Lowest parallel support surfaces of the base (not the recessed centre plane at Y=0). Mounting clocking and controller-base frame remain unverified.

flange_distal_face.interpretation: Measured distal J6 plane and eight CAD cylinder bores of 5mm diameter on 92mm PCD. Official mechanical manual PDF page 56 specifies 8-M6 threaded holes, depth 10mm; 5mm is the modeled tap-drill/core geometry, NOT the nominal fastener diameter. Tool clocking/control flange axes still require documentation.

not_inferred: mounting orientation about the installation axis
